errors.text_span: 左图（a）标题为“各语体中支撑动词的二级语义分布”
errors.evidence: The title for chart (a) is “各语体中支配动词的二级语义域分布” (distribution of secondary semantic domains of controlling verbs). The description incorrectly uses “支撑动词” (supporting verbs).

errors.text_span: 右图（b）标题为“各语体中受词动词的语义分布”
errors.evidence: The title for chart (b) is “各语体中承受动词的二级语义域分布” (distribution of secondary semantic domains of patient verbs). The description incorrectly shortens “二级语义域分布” to “语义分布”.

errors.text_span: 在左图中，水平轴列出了四种语体，分别为“语体1”、“语体2”、“语体3”和“语体4”。
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not have these generic labels. The labels are “新闻” (News), “传统文学” (Traditional Literature), “网络小说” (Web Fiction), and “微博” (Weibo).

errors.text_span: 每个堆叠柱状图代表一种语体
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Each of the four main categories on the x-axis has two stacked bars, one for “男性” (male) and one for “女性” (female).
The description completely omits the grouping of bars under each main x-axis category. Both charts show two bars for each category, labeled “男性” (male) and “女性” (female).

errors.text_span: 其中最高的柱状图（语体3）接近5000
errors.evidence: The highest bar in chart (a) has a labeled value of 5849. Describing this as 'close to 5000' is a significant understatement. The label '语体3' is also incorrect.

The shortest bars in chart (a) are under “传统文学” (Traditional Literature) with values of 14 and 16. No bar has a value of approximately 1000, and the bars for the first category, “新闻” (News), are 469 and 4156.

errors.text_span: 在语体3中，约96%的频次归于“语义类别1”。
errors.evidence: The bar with the 96% stack corresponds to the '女性' (female) group under '网络小说' (Web Fiction), not a generic '语体3'. Attributing it to '语义类别1' is also a placeholder, as the specific category name is in the legend, not labeled on the bar.

errors.text_span: 在右图中，水平轴列出了从1到10的类别标签，但未明确标注具体类别名称。
errors.evidence: This is a complete hallucination. The horizontal axis in chart (b) has the same four categories as chart (a): “新闻”, “传统文学”, “网络小说”, and “微博”.

errors.text_span: 其中一个类别（类别6）的频次最高，接近6000
errors.evidence: This is a hallucination. There is no category labeled '类别6'. The highest bar in chart (b) is for the '女性' (female) group under '网络小说' (Web Fiction), with a value of 5738.
